batting.name: CA Pujara
batting.dismissal: c DA Miller b P Awana

batting.name: KL Rahul
batting.dismissal: c Mandeep Singh b Azhar Mahmood

batting.name: Azhar Mahmood
batting.dismissal: c AB de Villiers b JD Unadkat

balls.text: Mahmood bounces the batsman, Rahul hooks, Mandeep is on the square leg boundary and runs to his right to hold the catch
Rahul walks across his stumps to try and paddle but gets beaten by a full ball that misses leg stump
terrific placement from the new boy! Rahul carts a slower ball into the gap on the extra cover boundary, cleared his front foot and swung hard
Rahul slashes at a full ball and manages to slice it past the man at short third man, RCB get to 170 ...

lbw! The umpire is quick to send Kohli on his way. Kohli played a strange shot. He kept his back leg planted right in front of the stumps, cleared his front foot and then tried to play a reverse paddle past short third man. He was struck plumb in front by a yorker
he follows Kohli, who had moved outside leg stump, with a full ball. Kohli clips it towards deep square leg and the throw back to the keeper is poor
another one in the blockhole, Henriques can only play it back to the bowler
bowled him! AB moved across his stumps to try and paddle past short fine leg. Awana had bowled the yorker and it demolished middle and leg stump. Six and out.
what a start that is! AB moves across his crease, clears his front foot, and swings a length ball over deep midwicket. He's been batting at the nets before this, hasn't he?

Awana's broken off stump a third up from the base! Gayle made room but Awana's yorker beat the bat and crashed into off stump. The umpire checks to see if Awana's front foot is okay, it is, just about
a superb ball followed by utter rubbish, a high full toss outside off stump, Gayle carves it over the point boundary and it's a no-ball for height too
Gayle's fallen on his backside after trying to dig out a yorker that tailed into him, superb delivery, Gayle's lying flat on the pitch
Kohli has to negotiate a blockhole delivery and he plays it through the leg side
in the blockhole, Kohli makes room and digs it out towards cover, the bowler runs across to field it himself
a full toss and Kohli has put it away to bring up his 50 off 39 balls. He came forward and flicked it towards deep square leg, beating the diving fielder on the boundary
Gayle swings across the line but misses and gets hit on the pad by a full ball
that's bounced on the sight screen. Gayle clears his front foot and slams a length ball back over the bowler's head
a full toss outside off, Gayle clears his front foot and hits the ball flat and hard, it just clears the extra cover boundary. Actually it did not. Bounced just inside the boundary
Gayle clears his front foot and slogs, the top edge goes high in the air towards long off, Chawla comes running in and lets the ball bounce in front of him so that he can field the free hit cleanly
in the blockhole from round the wicket, Kohli plays it on the leg side, but it's another front foot no-ball. Gayle has another free hit coming up. It's a tight call for no-ball.
Kohli drives a good length ball through midwicket, that ends a terrific over from Mahmood, economy wise
a yorker, and Gayle can only dig it out on the leg side
a leg side-full toss, Gayle swings but misses again, he gets hit on the pad

another full toss, a higher one this time, Kohli pulls it but hasn't hit it properly. Sandeep runs in from the deep midwicket boundary and dives forward to take the catch. The umpires are going to check if it's a no-ball for height. But it looks like Mahmood has over-stepped. It's a front-foot no-ball. Gayle will be on strike for the free-hit. A good over so far for Kings XI is going pear shaped.
Kohli steps out of his crease, Mahmood bowls a full toss angling into the right-hander and cramping him for room. Kohli gets hit on the thigh
Mahmood delivers the yorker, Kohli plays it back to the bowler, Mahmood lunges to his right to field
a thigh high full toss, and Gayle clips it towards deep square leg
another full toss, and once again Awana gets away with it, Gayle hits it along the ground to the fielder at cow corner
in the blockhole on middle stump, Kohli plays it towards point
a full toss, and Kohli swings across the line, sending the ball racing towards cow corner, Mandeep dives superbly to save the boundary
a straight half-volley, Kohli drills it down the ground with a blistering drive, the 100 partnership comes up off 68 balls
a length ball angling into Kohli, who moves forward, gets low, and swings across the line. the ball sails over deep midwicket
he's escaped there! A full toss on the pads, Gayle fails to get under it and hits it along the ground through square leg
Gony moves to his right during his follow through to intercept a Kohli drive
short ball angling into the left-hander from round the wicket, Gayle pulls along the ground to deep square
Gony's feeling it for sure, the heat of Gayle. He's bowled a wide outside off stump
three in a row! A half volley outside off, Gayle stays in his crease, gets under it, and hammers the ball over long off, that's his 50
Gayle's on his way now, the length is full on leg and middle, Gayle swings and the next thing everyone sees is the ball flying over deep midwicket
short ball, Gayle simply stays in his crease and flat-bats it, slams it over long on, many many rows back
short of a length outside off, Gayle drives it hard towards wide long off, Sathish sprints to his right to save the boundary
that was the straighter one and Kohli tried to cut it from middle stump, it was full as well, the ball goes on the off side off the bottom edge
Kohli goes back to a fuller ball and plays it back to the bowler
played on the leg side from the crease
Gayle steps out and hits the ball hard and straight, beating the fielder at long on
short length once again, Kohli goes back and hits the ball hard through cover
the quicker ball bowled short outside off, Kohli waits and dabs it past the fielder at short third man
Gayle takes his bottom hand off the bat as he flays at the ball, he hits it to point
Kohli steps out and lofts the ball flat towards long-off, it doesn't reach the fielder on the full
Gayle heaves at a good length ball, aiming to clear the wide long-on boundary, he gets a thick inside edge toward deep square leg
a slower ball bowled full outside off, it's very close to the wide line, and the umpire calls it
that's down leg side, first wide of the innings, first extra of the innings in fact
Gony responds with a sharp bouncer that has Gayle rushing for cover
finally Gayle cuts loose! He gets the ball in his arc, full and around off, he swings across the line and slams it over wide long-on
good length on leg and middle, Gayle stays in his crease and plays towards the bowler
the quick ball this time, Gayle hits it along the ground to long off
that's the slower legbreak, Gayle plays it off his pads towards midwicket
another quick cross-seam delivery, Gayle stays in his crease and drives towards wide long off
goes back into his crease and nudges the ball off his pads through square leg
there's the first six of the innings! Kohli skips down the pitch to get to the pitch of the ball and drives it cleanly over long off
that's the legbreak from Chawla, tossed up and full, Gayle drives to long off
Kohli gets beaten as he tries to dab a short of a length ball from outside off towards third man
good length and straight, Gayle simply punches to long off for a single
Kohli creams a full ball through cover with a flowing drive, Vohra runs to his right on the boundary and makes the save
Kohli moves forward and drives the ball to the fielder at mid-off, he decides not to run
a fuller ball outside off, Kohli drives crisply but can't beat cover
edged and four! Kohli was unsure about whether to go forward or stay back. He ended up prodding outside off stump and the ball went so fine that it beat third man
Chawla bowls another medium-pace delivery to Gayle, who plays it back to the bowler
another cross-seam quick ball, Gayle defends on the off side
Kohli pulls, but the ball is fuller and quicker so the timing of the shot isn't perfect, it goes towards deep square leg
defended on the from foot on the leg side
Gayle pushes the ball off his pads towards long on for one more
tossed up on middle and leg, Kohli steps out, makes a little room, and drives to long off
short and wide outside off, Gony gets away with that one. Kohli's cut wasn't perfectly timed and the ball goes off the bottom towards third man
driven from the crease towards long off
a terrible ball, full outside leg stump, and when fine leg is in the circle. Gayle merely gets some bat on it to send the ball to the fine-leg boundary. He reclaims the orange cap from Michael Hussey
Kohli moves forward and pushes a good length ball in front of point for a single
a full ball and Gayle pushes it back towards the bowler, Gony makes a lazy effort to stop it on his follow through and lets the ball go past him
short of a length outside off, Kohli punches off the back foot through point for a single
Kohli goes back and cuts a good length ball in front of point
Gayle gets a thick outside edge towards short third man where a mis-field allows the single
that's a cross-seam delivery which is much quicker, it slides across Gayle and beats the bat
Gayle pushes forward to defend and is beaten by one that slides on with the arm
angling into middle and leg, Kohli gets his pads out of the way and drives to long on
a full ball on off and middle, Kohli strides forward and plays to cover
fuller and straighter, driven back to the bowler
such a hit-me ball that was, short and so wide. Gayle stays in his crease and cuts hard to score his first boundary of the innings
driven on the up towards the man on the cover boundary
nearly in the blockhole once again, Gayle plays it towards long on
Gayle swings at a good length ball, Gayle misses

a huge appeal for lbw after Gayle gets hit by a full ball right in front of the stumps, It looks like it pitched in line with the stumps too, despite Awana bowling from over the wicket. Gayle's lucky. Big break for RCB. That was crashing into middle and leg

a neat flick and it beats a diving Vohra on the deep midwicket boundary. Kohli moved forward and across and played the ball with the angle into him. Vohra had to cover ground from deep square leg and he did not make it
a length ball on the pads, Gayle stays in his crease and flicks towards deep midwicket
nearly in the blockhole, Gayle digs it out towards cover. Sandeep has been impressive once again today. Have Kings XI discovered him too late?
Gayle stays in his crease and defends a good length ball towards point
Gayle charges and swings, but gets beaten by a ball that pitches on a length and keeps lower than the batsman expected as it seams past off stump
Gayle lets a good length ball go outside off, as it slants across him from over the wicket
pushed off the front foot towards point
whoops, that kept low outside off and beat Kohli, bounced a second time before reaching Gilchrist
a sublime drive, Kohli eases on to the front foot and languidly drives a length ball through cover, he held his pose on his follow through and watched the ball race to the boundary
good length around off once again, not as much swing for Awana, Kohli gets behind the line and blocks
good length around off stump, Kohli plays from his crease towards mid-on

caught at point! Miller dives forward to take the catch inches from the ground as it dipped on him. The delivery was on a good length and seamed away from the right-hander a little. Pujara tried to drive on the up through cover but got a thick outside edge
a slower ball outside off, Pujara plays it towards mid off and takes a single to retain the strike
Pujara's missed out there, there was so much width outside off but his square drive went straight to point
Gayle drops the ball close on the off side and runs another single, that's only his 5th ball
the line is outside off stump this time and Pujara mis-times a drive towards wide mid-off, Gayle wasn't too quick between the wickets once again
Pujara moves forward and across, to get inside the line of the swinging ball, and flicks it in the air towards the long leg boundary
the full ball swings into the right-hander once again, Pujara closes the face to play through midwicket and gets a leading edge towards cover
full and on the pads, Pujara turns it off his pads through square leg
good length on middle, Pujara stays in his crease and plays it to midwicket
short ball and Gayle pulls along the ground, there's protection at deep square leg
a fuller and slower ball, Pujara waits in his crease and nudges it into the leg side
Pujara drives a fuller ball but doesn't time it well, can't pierce the gap between mid on and mid off
good length on off and middle, Pujara meets it on the front foot and defends towards the bowler
Gayle gets squared up and beaten by one that pitches on a good length on middle and seams away from the left-hander
shorter length for the first time this over, Pujara waits in his crease and opens the face to steer towards third man
Pujara plays straighter this time, pushing the swinging ball towards mid off
a loud and confident appeal for lbw after the full ball hoops into Pujara and beats his flick to hit the pad, that was missing leg stump
full and inswinging once again, Pujara stays in his crease and plays it to mid-on
the full ball swings big into the right-hander, but it swings on to Pujara's pads, and he flicks the ball neatly to the midwicket boundary
a full and slower ball in the blockhole outside off, Gayle stays back and tries to defend but is beaten
good length angling into the right hander from over the wicket, Pujara works the ball through midwicket
Mahmood swings a yorker back into Gayle, who digs it out on the off side. He runs a quick single and there's a direct hit at the bowler's end this time. Gayle's safe though
Gayle was a goner had Chawla hit direct from mid-on! Pujara pushed the full ball and set off. Gayle wasn't too keen but he responded. He wasn't too quick either but Chawla missed
this time he's found the gap, the line and length from Mahmood allowed Pujara to go back and cut the ball between two fielders at point
short of a length with width outside of, it's there to be hit and Pujara plays the back-foot punch, doesn't beat cover though

that's the winning blow! Sathish hits a length ball through the line and sends it flaying past the fielder at mid-on. Gilchrist has finally come good this season and seen the chase through, and it's come at a terrible time for the RCB
another one bearly in the blockhole, just outside off, Sathish stays back and drives in front of point
in the blockhole, the batsman plays it towards mid-on
short ball, Sathish sends it over the square leg boundary with a well-balanced pull
Gilchrist plays the ball down near his feet and sprints through
Gilchrist would have been gone had Gayle hit at the striker's end from point, Sathish had mis-timed the shot
Gilchrist works a full toss off his hips behind square
Sathish pushes forward and defends on the leg side
ah, Miller did not know too much about that. He played all around one that went on with the arm and is bowled between bat and pad
this time he mis-times the slog sweep towards short fine leg
another one! Gilchrist goes down on one knee and slog sweeps over the square leg boundary, Kings XI sprinting towards this target
a terrific shot! Gilchrist charges, gets to the pitch of the ball, and lofts cleanly over the extra cover boundary
flicked off the pads for a single
he's edged another one for four! Gilchrist charges and swings, trying to hit inside out over cover, instead he gets a thick edge that flies wide of the keeper and races to the third man boundary
short ball and Miller pulls towards deep square leg
Miller works the ball off his pads but can't beat short fine leg
full ball on middle stump, Gilchrist drives towards long on for a single

caught at long off! He lofted a full ball down the ground but connected with the bottom of the bat. AB ran in and caught it easily. But is it too late for the RCB? Mahmood goes after a superb half-century
Mahmood clears his front foot and lofts the ball over the infield, the ball rolls down to the extra cover boundary, Zaheer lumbers towards it and tumbles and somehow manages to prevent the four
cut hard off the back foot towards deep cover
Mahmood has smashed it again! Hit extremely hard down the ground and neither long-on or long-off has any chance

what's happened there? Gilchrist tried to pull one that was a bit full and top edged it over the keeper, Karthik did not known where it was, it was his catch, Gayle eventually sauntered from short third man and fielded the ball
superb Gilchirst! Skips down the pitch, gets to the pitch of the delivery and lofts it back over the bowler's head for a one-bounce four
driven hard to long on for a single this time
he's hammered it! Mahmood rocks back to a short ball and heaves it over the long-on boundary to bring up his 50 and the 100 partnership
superbly placed! Gilchrist steps out and outside leg to make room and drive a full toss into the gap on the extra cover boundary
Zaheer delivers an outstanding yorker, and Gilchrist brings his bat down in time to inside edge it on to his boot
Gilchrist tries to cut but doesn't have the room, he is beaten by the extra bounce close to off stump
another full toss, Mahmood stays in his crease and drives to long off
a full toss and Gilchrist cuts it in front of point
that's definitely out of the middle! Gilchrist brings up his first 50 of the season by charging the bowler and carting a length ball straight back over his head, that cleared the sight screen
Gilchirst swivels pulls to short fine leg, another mis-timed shot, and he moves to 49
backs away outside leg stump once again and drives towards long on
shot! Terrible length, allows Mahmood the freedom to back away, create room, and slap the ball over extra cover
fuller length, angling into off and middle, Gilchrist drives the ball along the ground to cow corner
short of a length ball and Gilchrist plays his trademark swivel pull, back in the day he would have sent that for six, but his placement is still superb, one-bounce four
Mahmood makes room against a good length ball on off stump and cuts in front of point
Gilchrist is beaten by a searing yorker

Gilchrist charges and tries to loft down the ground, he ends up mis-timing it over cover, Kohli sprints back and dives full length, he manages to get fingertips on it, most people would not have got close
length ball on the pads, Gilchrist can't beat short fine leg with his swing
Mahmood makes room once again and cuts towards third man
Mahmood backs away and lofts a good length ball over extra cover, placed it well enough to get two
length ball and Mahmood moves back and across to pull that ball through square leg, the umpire skips out of the way
played through midwicket for a single
Mahmood slogs across the line, lofting the ball towards the cow corner boundary, a clean strike but he seems to be cramping now
steps out of his crease to play on the leg side but isn't to the pitch of the ball, the ball hits the pad for a leg bye
he's middled one! Gilchrist gets down on one knee and sweeps a short ball to the square leg boundary, cleared his front foot and made clean contact
Mahmood steps out, doesn't get to the pitch of the ball, and mis-times the whip on the leg side
Murali drops a bit short outside off and Mahmood mis-times the back foot drive to cover
short of a length outside off stump, Mahmood goes back and drives on the up through cover
nearly in the blockhole and Gilchrist stays back and drives on the off side, top over so far, just two off it, one ball to go
Gilchirst backs away to cut but misses the ball
Gilchirst has no room to pull, he goes back to try but is severely cramped by a short of a length ball that angles into him, the ball hits high on the bat and lobs very close on the leg side
Gilchrist backs away and drives a full ball from off and middle stump to cover, doesn't find the gap
Vinay cramps Mahmood for room as he backs away towards leg, the batsman dabs on the off side
played with an open face to steer the ball to third man
Mahmood backs away to a slower ball and checks his shot as he lofts over extra cover, he still managed to make good contact and placed it into the gap on the boundary
Gilchrist gets hit on the pad by one that tails into him, a yorker, Unadkat appeals but that was missing leg
he's middled this, well not quite, he cleared his front foot and swung across the line, carting the ball to the square leg boundary. The bat turned in his hand
Gilchirst's not middling them at all, but he's getting them away, this time he swings across the line at a slower ball on a good length and the top edge flies over the keeper
length ball angling across the right-hander from over the wicket, Mahmood waits in his crease and steers it to third man
Gilchrist pulls again but once again mis-times it, the ball lobs over the in-field and falls safely

a full ball angling into the left-hander from round the wicket, Gilchrist swings across the line and mis-times it, but he got enough on it to send the ball over the infield and into the gap on the wide long-on boundary
Mahmmod throws his bat at a length ball and manages to place it behind point
short ball, too short, it's over the batsman's head
that would have been out had there been a direct hit! Gilchrist played towards midwicket and Mahmood set off, Gilchrist sent him back, Mahmood was a long way out
Mahmood moves outside leg stump and Vinay follows him, cramping the batsman for room, Mahmood nudges the ball towards square
good length, angling into off stump, defended on the front foot towards the off side
Mahmood goes back and cuts the ball from off stump for a single
a huge appeal for lbw, Murali can't believe it's not out. Gilchrist came forward and closed the face of the bat and was hit plumb in front by the doosra, don't think the umpire picked it either
cut off the back foot through point this time
short ball outside off, Mahmood cuts off the back foot but doesn't beat Zaheer at point
Gilchrist pushes forward slightly tentatively and nudges towards point
tossed up full from over the wicket, Mahmood nudges on the leg side
Mahmmod moves forward and dabs a good length ball on the off side, calls Gilchrist through immediately
three fours in a row! A length ball outside off this time and Mahmood simply hits through the line, lofting the ball over mid-off for a one-bounce four
another short one, this one gets up higher but Mahmood is still able to swivel and pull over midwicket and to the boundary
short, too short and Mahmood swivels and pulls to the deep midwicket boundary, he had lots of time to play that shot
another yorker, and Mahmood can only dig it out on the off side
in the blockhole, Mahmood manages to keep it out and play it back to the bowler
Mahmmod drives towards mid off and sprints the single
Gilchrist tries to hit down the ground but gets an inside edge on to the pad

short of a length angling into the left-hander, Gilchrist pulls but mis-times it horribly. The ball lobs up but Muralitharan at midwicket is slow in responding and back-pedalling, eventually the ball drops over his head
Mahmood drives a full toss hard and straight but Gilchrist fails to get out of the way in time, the ball crashes into his pad, that would have been four otherwise
full on the pads, Gilchrist stays in his crease and whips it towards the fielder at deep square leg, along the ground
good length, pitching outside off and heading towards the wickets, Gilchrist goes back and defends back to the bowler
driven off the front foot to cover
that's a bit too full to go back to and whip off his pads but he does it anyway, playing it to deep square leg
short and wide outside off, rather high too, Gilchrist plays a chippy cut over point, Kohli and Henriques in hot pursuit, Henriques wins. Unadkat slipped and fell after he delivered
Unadkat nips the ball into Gilchrist after pitching outside off and the batsman defends from his crease
Gilchrist charges and has a blind slog at a short of a length ball, he was no where near that
good length around off and middle, a tight start, Glchrist stays in his crease and defends
a full ball angling across the right-hander before shaping back in a little, Mahmood drives to point
a length ball with lots of width outside off, Mahmood cuts but can't get it past the man at point
good length on middle stump, Mahmood gets behind the line and blocks

that is some reply from Zaheer! He pulled the length back, pitched outside off, and nipped the ball into the left-hander. Marsh drove off the front foot, leaving a gap between bat and pad, and Zaheer found it. The ball uprooted off stump.
a half-volley on the pads, Marsh clips it off his pads so sweetly that the fielder at deep square leg has no chance

back in the day Gilchrist would have sent that soaring over deep square leg. This time his swing connected with nothing and he was hit on the thigh by a length ball that angled into him from over the wicket
driven towards mid off
and he plays a cracking shot, driving a full ball dead straight, nearly brushing the stumps at the bowler's end, it misses them though and races to the boundary
Gilchrist goes back and swats a good length ball through midwicket, the fielder at mid-on has to do the fielding
width outside off and Gilchrist goes after it, he cuts hard and the top edge clears the leaping Gayle at first slip and goes to the third man boundary
good length and straight, Gilchrist stays in his crease and defends
that's very wide down leg side and Arun Karthik has saved four runs in wides by diving full length to his right
full an wide outside off stump, Gilchrist cuts hard towards point where the fielder dives to his left and takes pace off the shot
Gilchrist goes back and nudges the ball towards midwicket to keep the strike
Arun Karthik leaps to his right to collect one that slants down leg side
good length around off and middle, Gilchrist goes back and defends on the off side, Zaheer does the fielding himself
a full delivery around off stump, Gilchrist stays in his crease and drives on the up through extra cover, finding the gap in the in field
this time it's a wide down leg side
quite wide outside off, Gilchrist swings and misses

it's all happening! Gilchrist plays a cracking drive to a full ball swinging away from him. Kohli dived at point to stop the shot and parried it towards AB at cover. AB picked up and threw to Zaheer, who failed to collect the ball. Marsh was scrambling back to his crease and dived full length. He might have been short
full outside off stump, swinging away from the left-hander, Gilchrist drives away from his body and is beaten
